relations: Ophelia 与 Dante 是 mate，共享 bond 能脑内对话；Dante 绰号 Inferno。
Ophelia 是 fallen angel，当年建造监狱魔法；River 与 Jazz 帮她核过地图，River 帮里也有无辜者。
Reaper 是囚犯头目，从未收过无辜者，长年破坏监狱魔法，还想杀建筑师让监狱崩塌。
Willard 是她在 Reaper 楼层救出的第一名无辜囚犯，浑身淤青，自任贴身保镖。

facts.fact: 她耗尽魔力十六夜后动身潜回监狱救其余无辜者。
facts.anchor: After sixteen nights of exhausting my magic, I was ready to make my trip into the penitentiary

facts.fact: Dante 坚决反对她独行，说立刻上车赶来，要她等他。
facts.anchor: Wait for me to get there. I'm getting in my car right now

facts.fact: 她检查发现编织被扭碎撕裂——有人长期攻击，无法修复只能整体解编。
facts.anchor: My complex weave had been gnarled. Torn. Shredded in some spots

facts.fact: Reaper 冷触须把她拖到牢栏，双手穿栏掐住气道，她的翅膀消失。
facts.anchor: Reaper cut off my airway with ease. My wings vanished

facts.fact: 她把数十根黑暗死线射进 Reaper 手腕，趁松动挣脱逃跑。
facts.anchor: I sent dozens of the dark, deadly threads of power I had, straight into the wrists

facts.fact: 她用极微魔法解锁第一间牢门放出无辜者，警告：她死了电梯就不动。
facts.anchor: It only took the tiniest blip of magic to unlock the cell, and I yanked the door open

facts.fact: Smith 报告距解锁还有一小时；Dante 命她花三十分钟补魔后建墙。
facts.anchor: Spend thirty minutes refueling," Dante instructed me. "We're going to need you to build a wall, Angel

facts.fact: 最后一批人刚绑好掩护魔法，墙炸成百万黑丝线，电梯门赶在冷触须前关上。
facts.anchor: hiding them from my fucked up prison, just as my wall exploded into millions of tiny, onyx threads
